description: Land Acquisition - Guluwana, Rathnapura D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and claimants. It involves the declaration that certain lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) dealing with land acquisitions and property matters. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration process and does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
